findings.text: The operator's Test D ('empty pick') never exercised the empty-pick detection branch it claims to verify: the test repo has no .gitignore, so the keeper's runtime files (agent/gitkeeper.log + agent/gitkeeper.lock) are committed by 'git add -A' and make the cherry-pick NON-empty — my inspection of the healed commit (602169b) shows it carries exactly those two noise files while the state change was already on origin. The test passed through the normal success path; had the /nothing to commit|empty/i regex been broken, Test D would still have passed. My own ADV-1 (noise gitignored, mirroring the real repo — whose auto-saves carry only the 6 state files) proves the branch itself is correct: the detection fired, exit 0, no garbage commit. race-test.sh has a nesting quirk: setup() re-cds to 'dirname $0' with a RELATIVE path, so each test nests one level deeper (T/, T/T/, ... T/T/T/T/T/ after one full run). Harmless for results (each test is self-contained; keepers install by absolute path — this inspection verified the per-test logs), but the working tree accumulates nested directories and the 'current' directory after the run is not the script's home. My adv-test.sh uses an absolute BASE (and hit the same bug before I fixed it — a useful reminder of why the operator's own test needs the fix).

One new glyph in the hardened keeper: ← (U+2190 LEFTWARDS ARROW) in the 'ORIG_HEAD ← our snapshot' comment — same logic-arrow family as the committed → (U+2192) and the R71-approved ⇒ (U+21D2); not an emoji. Zero emoji ranges in both staged files; all other non-ASCII is pre-existing (·, —, …, →, ⇄, ─, Hebrew).

In the heal-conflict path (measured live in ADV-3), the keeper logs both 'heal conflict — snapshot dropped, origin keeps the truth' AND the pre-existing 'commit ok, push FAILED (kept local)' — the second wording is imprecise (the snapshot was actually discarded by reset --hard + aborted pick, nothing is kept locally). The state records pushed:false + pushError 'heal-conflict' honestly, so no book lies; pre-existing wording, non-blocking, fold into any future keeper touch.

The incident's tell, worth recording in the books as a detection heuristic: dac4d1e's message said '8 files' (the status-porcelain count of the run's own writes) while the commit carried 9 (the stale-index wholesale re-commit adds every foreign mid-run edit). Post-fix, the healed commit is a cherry-pick of the run's own snapshot, so message-count == commit-content again; any future mismatch of this shape means the old heal is running somewhere (e.g., a straggler checkout) and should be investigated.
